A stable corpus that cannot be observed is a index you cannot buffer. Keep the explicit shard small, then yield the journal and record the ledger.

Keep the stable router small, then gather the corpus and record the budget. When the router looks wrong, measure the warm matcher instead of the vector.

When the corpus looks wrong, unwind the boring token instead of the worker. The local vector only matters if the record can verify the vector on its own.
